outline:
Course Title: Dynamics (動力學)
Pre-requisite: 3001011 or approved by the course instructor.
Course Contents: Force, mass, and acceleration, particle kinematics, particle dynamics, work and energy, impulse and momentum, rigid body motion, and dynamics of the rigid body system.
General applications, vehicle dynamics, and railway vehicles will be introduced, such as basic dynamics, vehicle dynamics, wheel-rail coupling, railway vehicle climbing and slipping, aerodynamics, vehicle dynamics and resistance of railway vehicles, railway vehicle braking, and applications of railway vehicles.
This course can be counted for credits if pursuing a micro-program in railway vehicles.
The course is based on 16 + 2 weeks of flexible learning.

flexible_learning.content:
Weeks 17 & 18 are scheduled as flexible independent learning. You would need to form a group of 3-4, use what you have learned in the semester, and combine with an AI tool to solve a problem.
1.	Form a group of 3-4
2.	Use AI to solve the problem
3.	Write your report with “Given”, “Find”, and “SOL”
4.	Write your report by hand. No computer output report is allowed
5.	Everyone turns in their own report to the e-Learning system.
flexible_learning.outcome:
The goal is to understand the course content. Students may use an AI tool to solve the problem and gain a comprehensive understanding of the problem while learning through the exercise.

Every individual needs to turn in their own report. No report, no points.
